integrity: The derivation uses an exact jump-moment identity. Six analytic-ODE checks, one zero-reset benchmark and three independently simulated finite-time comparisons passed. Infinite-time limits are proved by Beta-integral analysis rather than finite tests.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns equilibrium-initialized real generator eigenobservables with finite nonzero variance and valid Dynkin product identities.
The conclusions are exact finite-time second moments and their asymptotic rates, not full distributional limit laws or a general ergodicity-breaking assertion.
Publication priority may be affected by a broader unindexed theorem about path-dependent preferential relocation.
title: A spectral threshold for time-average fluctuations under preferential relocation
